(Yogaśikhopaniṣad
Av. consists of two recensions namely southern an. northern. The northern resension has been incorporated in the first adhy. of southern recension. The whole text consists of 6 adhys. containing 392 ślokas; the 2nd an. 3rd Adhyayas are called Dīpaśikhopaniṣad; some mss. gives the alternate title a. Yogaśikṣopaniṣad. Recensions not mentioned in Catalogues.
